601:  * Description:
602:  *   Configure a single ESMART REGION0 to scan out an RGB888 framebuffer,

605:  *   the start of the next frame.
606:  *
607:  *   The ESMART layer (not CLUSTER) is used because it is the plain
608:  *   uncompressed raster window -- the natural fit for a regular RGB
609:  *   framebuffer (no FBCD compression state machine to bring up).
610:  ****************************************************************************/

612: static void rk3576_vop_configure_layer(FAR struct rk3576_vop_s *priv)
613: {
614:   uint32_t esmart_base = RK3576_VOP_ESMART(priv->base, RK3576_VOP_ESMART_IDX);

622:   /* Disable the VOP's automatic clock gating.  The reset value has gating ON,
623:    * and both bits are cleared here: the hardware may otherwise decide a block
624:    * looks idle, gate its aclk, and stop its fetch with no error reported at
625:    * all.  The remaining gating bits are left as the hardware set them. */

627:   {
628:     uint32_t gate = rk3576_vop_getreg(

630:     uint32_t fixed = gate & ~(RK3576_VOP_AUTO_GATING_EN |
631:                               RK3576_VOP_ACLK_PRE_AUTO_GATING_EN);
632: 
633:     rk3576_vop_putreg(priv, sys_base + RK3576_VOP_SYS_AUTO_GATING_CTRL_IMD,
634:                       fixed);
635:   }
636: 
637:   /* AXI read IDs: this window's own pair, not the reset defaults.  0x0a/0x0b
638:    * belongs to Esmart2, which fetches on axi1.  Only the two ID fields are
639:    * written; dma_rreq_hurry_en with thold = 0 would hold a priority request

647:                          << RK3576_VOP_ESMART_CTRL1_UV_ID_SHIFT));

649:   /* AXI control: MMU bypass (REGION0_YRGB_MST is a physical address) plus the
650:    * 4k-boundary burst optimisation.  The low bits are dma_sop(0) / axi_sel(1)

653:    * No outstanding bound: outstanding_en is left at 0, i.e. "as many as the
654:    * interconnect accepts".  mmu_bypass is set because this driver programs
655:    * physical addresses and has no IOMMU to drive.
656:    */
657: 
658:   /* Program the AXI channel first, then the rest.  RK3576 gives each ESMART
659:    * its own channel (ESMART0/1 on axi0, ESMART2/3 on axi1); MEASURED, a write
660:    * that sets axi_sel also clears bits [7:2] -- mmu_bypass, outstanding_en and
661:    * the count -- and a later write carrying axi_sel clears them again.  That

743:    * rb_swap is NOT a "make RGB work" flag, despite the TRM's swap table (11.3)
744:    * listing it against RGB888.  It says the FRAMEBUFFER is already stored as

751:    *
752:    * See the MIPI panel's MADCTL BGR bit for the other end of this one swap:

754:    */

### 核心链路梳理(RK3576 VOP = 3 video port + 3 POST 的架构)

```
DDR (framebuffer)
   ↓ AXI0
CLUSTER0_WIN0 (base 0x27D01000)  ← 读 fb 数据,格式/地址/stride

   ↓
```

### 可扩展路由接口设计(回答你的新要求)

TRM 确认每个输出接口有**独立的、结构完全相同的** `SYS_CTRL_*_INFACE_CTRL` 寄存器:

| 接口 | offset | 接口 | offset |
|------|--------|------|--------|
| MIPI0 | 0x0180 | DP0 | 0x018C |
| HDMI0 | 0x0184 | RGB | 0x0194 |
| EDP0 | 0x0188 | DP1/DP2 | 0x0198/0x019C(待最终核对) |

每个接口寄存器共享字段:`*_port_sel[3:2]`、`*_out_en[0]`、`*_clk_out_en[1]`、`*_dclk_sel[21]`、`*_pix_clk_sel[20]`、`*_split_en`、`*_vsync_pol/hsync_pol`、`*_data1_sel`。

**因此路由接口设计为接口无关的通用模型**:

```c
/* 输出接口枚举(泛化,不绑定 DSI) */
enum rk3576_vop_iface_e {
  RK3576_VOP_IFACE_MIPI_DSI = 0,
  RK3576_VOP_IFACE_HDMI,
  RK3576_VOP_IFACE_EDP,
  RK3576_VOP_IFACE_DP,
  RK3576_VOP_IFACE_RGB,
  RK3576_VOP_IFACE_MAX,
};

/* video port 选择 */
enum rk3576_vop_port_e {
  RK3576_VOP_PORT0 = 0,  /* dclk_vp0, 600MHz */
  RK3576_VOP_PORT1 = 1,  /* dclk_vp1, 300MHz */
  RK3576_VOP_PORT2 = 2,  /* dclk_vp2, 150MHz */
};
```

# drm/rockchip: vop: round\_up pitches to word align

VOP pitch register is word align, need align to word.

VOP\_WIN0\_VIR:
  bit\[31:16\] win0\_vir\_stride\_uv
    Number of words of Win0 uv Virtual width
  bit\[15:0\] win0\_vir\_width
    Number of words of Win0 yrgb Virtual width
    ARGB888 : win0\_vir\_width
    RGB888 : (win0\_vir\_width\*3/4) + (win0\_vir\_width%3)
    RGB565 : ceil(win0\_vir\_width/2)
    YUV : ceil(win0\_vir\_width/4)

Sascha Hauers.hauer@pengutronix.de[PATCH v5 03/23] drm/rockchip: dw_hdmi: rename vpll clock to reference clock2022-02-09T10:01:13Zurn:uuid:61bd59e5-6093-eb56-2c20-5834ebd5124f
"vpll" is a misnomer. A clock input to a device should be named after
the usage in the device, not after the clock that drives it. On the
rk3568 the same clock is driven by the HPLL.
To fix that, this patch renames the vpll clock to ref clock. The clock
name "vpll" is left for compatibility to old device trees.

Signed-off-by: Sascha Hauer <s.hauer@pengutronix.de>
---
 drivers/gpu/drm/rockchip/dw_hdmi-rockchip.c | 29 ++++++++++++---------
 1 file changed, 16 insertions(+), 13 deletions(-)

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/rockchip/dw_hdmi-rockchip.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/rockchip/dw_hdmi-rockchip.c
index 8677c8271678..e352e0404f77 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/rockchip/dw_hdmi-rockchip.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/rockchip/dw_hdmi-rockchip.c
@@ -69,7 +69,7 @@ struct rockchip_hdmi {
 	struct regmap *regmap;
 	struct drm_encoder encoder;
 	const struct rockchip_hdmi_chip_data *chip_data;
-	struct clk *vpll_clk;
+	struct clk *ref_clk;
 	struct clk *grf_clk;
 	struct dw_hdmi *hdmi;
 	struct phy *phy;
@@ -196,14 +196,17 @@ static int rockchip_hdmi_parse_dt(struct rockchip_hdmi *hdmi)
 		return PTR_ERR(hdmi->regmap);
 	}
 
-	hdmi->vpll_clk = devm_clk_get(hdmi->dev, "vpll");
-	if (PTR_ERR(hdmi->vpll_clk) == -ENOENT) {
-		hdmi->vpll_clk = NULL;
-	} else if (PTR_ERR(hdmi->vpll_clk) == -EPROBE_DEFER) {
+	hdmi->ref_clk = devm_clk_get(hdmi->dev, "ref");
+	if (PTR_ERR(hdmi->ref_clk) == -ENOENT)
+		hdmi->ref_clk = devm_clk_get(hdmi->dev, "vpll");
+
+	if (PTR_ERR(hdmi->ref_clk) == -ENOENT) {
+		hdmi->ref_clk = NULL;
+	} else if (PTR_ERR(hdmi->ref_clk) == -EPROBE_DEFER) {
 		return -EPROBE_DEFER;
-	} else if (IS_ERR(hdmi->vpll_clk)) {
-		DRM_DEV_ERROR(hdmi->dev, "failed to get vpll clock\n");
-		return PTR_ERR(hdmi->vpll_clk);
+	} else if (IS_ERR(hdmi->ref_clk)) {
+		DRM_DEV_ERROR(hdmi->dev, "failed to get reference clock\n");
+		return PTR_ERR(hdmi->ref_clk);
 	}
 
 	hdmi->grf_clk = devm_clk_get(hdmi->dev, "grf");
@@ -257,7 +260,7 @@ static void dw_hdmi_rockchip_encoder_mode_set(struct drm_encoder *encoder,
 {
 	struct rockchip_hdmi *hdmi = to_rockchip_hdmi(encoder);
 
-	clk_set_rate(hdmi->vpll_clk, adj_mode->clock * 1000);
+	clk_set_rate(hdmi->ref_clk, adj_mode->clock * 1000);
 }
 
 static void dw_hdmi_rockchip_encoder_enable(struct drm_encoder *encoder)
@@ -537,9 +540,9 @@ static int dw_hdmi_rockchip_bind(struct device *dev, struct device *master,
 		return ret;
 	}
 
-	ret = clk_prepare_enable(hdmi->vpll_clk);
+	ret = clk_prepare_enable(hdmi->ref_clk);
 	if (ret) {
-		DRM_DEV_ERROR(hdmi->dev, "Failed to enable HDMI vpll: %d\n",
+		DRM_DEV_ERROR(hdmi->dev, "Failed to enable HDMI reference clock: %d\n",
 			      ret);
 		return ret;
 	}
@@ -558,7 +561,7 @@ static int dw_hdmi_rockchip_bind(struct device *dev, struct device *master,
 	if (IS_ERR(hdmi->hdmi)) {
 		ret = PTR_ERR(hdmi->hdmi);
 		drm_encoder_cleanup(encoder);
-		clk_disable_unprepare(hdmi->vpll_clk);
+		clk_disable_unprepare(hdmi->ref_clk);
 	}
 
 	return ret;
@@ -570,7 +573,7 @@ static void dw_hdmi_rockchip_unbind(struct device *dev, struct device *master,
 	struct rockchip_hdmi *hdmi = dev_get_drvdata(dev);
 
 	dw_hdmi_unbind(hdmi->hdmi);
-	clk_disable_unprepare(hdmi->vpll_clk);
+	clk_disable_unprepare(hdmi->ref_clk);
 }

Sascha Hauers.hauer@pengutronix.de[PATCH v5 22/23] drm: rockchip: Add VOP2 driver2022-02-09T10:08:06Zurn:uuid:41dcdba7-f5e1-6a44-c67c-808fd24564f7
From: Andy Yan <andy.yan@rock-chips.com>

The VOP2 unit is found on Rockchip SoCs beginning with rk3566/rk3568.
It replaces the VOP unit found in the older Rockchip SoCs.

This driver has been derived from the downstream Rockchip Kernel and
heavily modified:

- All nonstandard DRM properties have been removed
- dropped struct vop2_plane_state and pass around less data between
  functions
- Dropped all DRM_FORMAT_* not known on upstream
- rework register access to get rid of excessively used macros
- Drop all waiting for framesyncs

The driver is tested with HDMI and MIPI-DSI display on a RK3568-EVB
board. Overlay support is tested with the modetest utility. AFBC support
on the cluster windows is tested with weston-simple-dmabuf-egl on
weston using the (yet to be upstreamed) panfrost driver support.

Signed-off-by: Sascha Hauer <s.hauer@pengutronix.de>
---

Notes:
    Changes since v4:
    - Avoid stack frame overflow by not allocating big array on the stack
    
    Changes since v3:
    - Sort includes
    - fix typos
    - Drop spinlock
    - Use regmap_set_bits()/regmap_clear_bits()
    - simplify vop2_scale_factor()
    - simplify vop2_afbc_transform_offset()

+
+/*
+ * VOP2 architecture
+ *
+ +----------+   +-------------+                                                        +-----------+
+ |  Cluster |   | Sel 1 from 6|                                                        | 1 from 3  |
+ |  window0 |   |    Layer0   |                                                        |    RGB    |
+ +----------+   +-------------+              +---------------+    +-------------+      +-----------+
+ +----------+   +-------------+              |N from 6 layers|    |             |
+ |  Cluster |   | Sel 1 from 6|              |   Overlay0    +--->| Video Port0 |      +-----------+
+ |  window1 |   |    Layer1   |              |               |    |             |      | 1 from 3  |
+ +----------+   +-------------+              +---------------+    +-------------+      |   LVDS    |
+ +----------+   +-------------+                                                        +-----------+
+ |  Esmart  |   | Sel 1 from 6|
+ |  window0 |   |   Layer2    |              +---------------+    +-------------+      +-----------+
+ +----------+   +-------------+              |N from 6 Layers|    |             | +--> | 1 from 3  |
+ +----------+   +-------------+   -------->  |   Overlay1    +--->| Video Port1 |      |   MIPI    |
+ |  Esmart  |   | Sel 1 from 6|   -------->  |               |    |             |      +-----------+
+ |  Window1 |   |   Layer3    |              +---------------+    +-------------+
+ +----------+   +-------------+                                                        +-----------+
+ +----------+   +-------------+                                                        | 1 from 3  |
+ |  Smart   |   | Sel 1 from 6|              +---------------+    +-------------+      |   HDMI    |
+ |  Window0 |   |    Layer4   |              |N from 6 Layers|    |             |      +-----------+
+ +----------+   +-------------+              |   Overlay2    +--->| Video Port2 |
+ +----------+   +-------------+              |               |    |             |      +-----------+
+ |  Smart   |   | Sel 1 from 6|              +---------------+    +-------------+      |  1 from 3 |
+ |  Window1 |   |    Layer5   |                                                        |    eDP    |
+ +----------+   +-------------+                                                        +-----------+
+ *
+ */
+
+enum vop2_data_format {
+	VOP2_FMT_ARGB8888 = 0,
+	VOP2_FMT_RGB888,
+	VOP2_FMT_RGB565,
+	VOP2_FMT_XRGB101010,
+	VOP2_FMT_YUV420SP,
+	VOP2_FMT_YUV422SP,
+	VOP2_FMT_YUV444SP,
+	VOP2_FMT_YUYV422 = 8,
+	VOP2_FMT_YUYV420,
+	VOP2_FMT_VYUY422,
+	VOP2_FMT_VYUY420,
+	VOP2_FMT_YUV420SP_TILE_8x4 = 0x10,
+	VOP2_FMT_YUV420SP_TILE_16x2,
+	VOP2_FMT_YUV422SP_TILE_8x4,
+	VOP2_FMT_YUV422SP_TILE_16x2,
+	VOP2_FMT_YUV420SP_10,
+	VOP2_FMT_YUV422SP_10,
+	VOP2_FMT_YUV444SP_10,
+};
+
+enum vop2_afbc_format {
+	VOP2_AFBC_FMT_RGB565,
+	VOP2_AFBC_FMT_ARGB2101010 = 2,
+	VOP2_AFBC_FMT_YUV420_10BIT,
+	VOP2_AFBC_FMT_RGB888,
+	VOP2_AFBC_FMT_ARGB8888,
+	VOP2_AFBC_FMT_YUV420 = 9,
+	VOP2_AFBC_FMT_YUV422 = 0xb,
+	VOP2_AFBC_FMT_YUV422_10BIT = 0xe,
+	VOP2_AFBC_FMT_INVALID = -1,
+};
+
+union vop2_alpha_ctrl {
+	uint32_t val;
+	struct {
+		/* [0:1] */
+		uint32_t color_mode:1;
+		uint32_t alpha_mode:1;
+		/* [2:3] */
+		uint32_t blend_mode:2;
+		uint32_t alpha_cal_mode:1;
+		/* [5:7] */
+		uint32_t factor_mode:3;
+		/* [8:9] */
+		uint32_t alpha_en:1;
+		uint32_t src_dst_swap:1;
+		uint32_t reserved:6;
+		/* [16:23] */
+		uint32_t glb_alpha:8;
+	} bits;
+};
+
+struct vop2_alpha {
+	union vop2_alpha_ctrl src_color_ctrl;
+	union vop2_alpha_ctrl dst_color_ctrl;
+	union vop2_alpha_ctrl src_alpha_ctrl;
+	union vop2_alpha_ctrl dst_alpha_ctrl;
+};
+
+struct vop2_alpha_config {
+	bool src_premulti_en;
+	bool dst_premulti_en;
+	bool src_pixel_alpha_en;
+	bool dst_pixel_alpha_en;
+	uint16_t src_glb_alpha_value;
+	uint16_t dst_glb_alpha_value;
+};
+
+struct vop2_win {
+	struct vop2 *vop2;
+	struct drm_plane base;
+	const struct vop2_win_data *data;
+	struct regmap_field *reg[VOP2_WIN_MAX_REG];
+
+	/**
+	 * @win_id: graphic window id, a cluster may be split into two
+	 * graphics windows.
+	 */
+	uint8_t win_id;
+
+	uint32_t offset;
+
+	uint8_t delay;
+	enum drm_plane_type type;
+};
+
+struct vop2_video_port {
+	struct drm_crtc crtc;
+	struct vop2 *vop2;
+	struct clk *dclk;
+	uint8_t id;
+	const struct vop2_video_port_regs *regs;
+	const struct vop2_video_port_data *data;
+
+	struct completion dsp_hold_completion;
+
+	/**
+	 * @win_mask: Bitmask of windows attached to the video port;
+	 */
+	uint32_t win_mask;
+
+	struct vop2_win *primary_plane;
+	struct drm_pending_vblank_event *event;
+
+	int nlayers;
+};
+
+struct vop2 {
+	struct device *dev;
+	struct drm_device *drm;
+	struct vop2_video_port vps[ROCKCHIP_MAX_CRTC];
+
+	const struct vop2_data *data;
+	/*
+	 * Number of windows that are registered as plane, may be less than the
+	 * total number of hardware windows.
+	 */
+	uint32_t registered_num_wins;
+
+	void __iomem *regs;
+	struct regmap *map;
+
+	struct regmap *grf;
+
+	/* physical map length of vop2 register */
+	uint32_t len;
+
+	void __iomem *lut_regs;
+
+	/* protects crtc enable/disable */
+	struct mutex vop2_lock;

# RK3576 HDMI: EDID-driven mode selection (2026-09-27)

Replaces the hard-coded 1080p60 timing with the sink's EDID preferred timing,
falling back to 1080p60 on any failure. Both configs (hdmi / mipi_dsi) build.

## Flow (boards/rk3576/kickpi-k7/src/kickpi_k7_hdmi.c)
TX_ON_H -> `rk3576_hdmi_initialize()` -> `kickpi_k7_hdmi_select_mode()`
-> `rk3576_hdmi_enable(mode.pixel_clock, 8)` -> VOP -> `start_video_path()`.
EDID must sit between initialize (configures DDC master + muxes pads) and
enable (programs the PHY PLL from the clock).

## ★ Include-guard collision (fixed) ★
`hardware/rk3576_hdmi.h` used `__VENDOR_ROCKCHIP_RK3576_RK3576_HDMI_H` — the
SAME guard as the public `chips/rk3576/rk3576_hdmi.h`. Whichever is included
first wins, so `rk3576_hdmi.c` (which includes hardware/ first) **never saw its
own public header**; prototypes were silently invisible and the file only
compiled because every function was defined before use.
Renamed to `__VENDOR_ROCKCHIP_RK3576_HARDWARE_RK3576_HDMI_H`
(convention: hardware/ headers use `..._HARDWARE_...`; see hardware/rk3576_gpio.h).
Lesson: if a project has both `foo.h` and `hardware/foo.h`, check the guards.

## DDC (built-in I2C master) — register facts
All in the always-on APB block, so usable BEFORE the PHY is up (that is why
EDID can be read before `enable()`).
- `I2CM_CONTROL0` 0x0ec: write 0x01 = software reset/bus clear.
- `I2CM_FM_SCL_CONFIG0` 0x0e4 = `0x085c085c` (~92 kHz @396 MHz, standard mode).
- `I2CM_INTERFACE_CONTROL0` 0x0f4:
  `I2CM_ADDR` 0x0ff000 [19:12] sub-address; `I2CM_SLVADDR` 0x000fe0 [11:5];
  **`I2CM_WR_MASK` 0x1e [4:1] is the COMMAND FIELD** — `EXT_READ`(4),
  `SHORT_READ`(3), `FM_READ`(2), `FM_WRITE`(1) all live INSIDE it, so a command
  is written *through* that mask and cleared by writing 0 through it.
  `FM_EN`(0) is the only bit outside the mask; reference leaves it 0.
- `I2CM_INTERFACE_CONTROL1` 0x0f8: SEG_PTR [14:7], SEG_ADDR [6:0]. Segment 0
  (base block) = 0; cleared at init so a stale segment cannot redirect a read.
- `I2CM_INTERFACE_RDDATA_0` 0x10c (low byte = the byte just read).
- Completion: `MAINUNIT_1_INT_STATUS` 0x3020 / `_MASK_N` 0x3024 / `_CLEAR` 0x3028,
  bits 0 = OP_DONE, 2 = NACK_RCVD. `_MASK_N` is active-low (1 = unmask).
  No IRQ handler in NuttX, so poll `_STATUS`; unmask around the transfer and
  re-mask after (mirrors the reference).
- One byte per transaction: SLVADDR at 0x50, sub-address 0..127 via I2CM_ADDR,
  command FM_READ, poll, read RDDATA & 0xff, clear command. 128 bytes ≈ tens of ms.

## ★ EDID DTD high-bit layout (this is where the bug was) ★
byte 4: [7:4] hactive[11:8]   [3:0] hblank[11:8]
byte 7: [7:4] vactive[11:8]   [3:0] vblank[11:8]
byte 11: [7:6] hfront[9:8]  [5:4] hsync width[9:8]
         [3:2] vfront[5:4]  [1:0] vsync width[5:4]
So the *MSB_SHIFT* macros must be the LEFT SHIFT applied after masking:
0xf0 -> 4, **0x0f -> 8** (NOT 0). Getting the blanking shift wrong makes
hblank 512 too small → hback underflows → the timing is rejected → silent
fallback. A 1080p60 DTD has hblank 280, i.e. it hits this on the very first try.
Verified with a host test using 1080p60 / 1024x768@60 / 1600x1200@60 (the last
has hsync width 272 = 0x110 and is the one that actually exercises byte 11).

## ⚠ Do NOT use <nuttx/video/edid.h>
Two upstream defects make it unusable for DTDs:
1. `EDID_DESC_HACTIVE/HBLANK` use the `_SHIFT` constants as MASKS
   (`byte & 4`, `byte & 0`) instead of `_MASK` (0xf0/0x0f), and the shifts are
   swapped (`<<4` where `<<8` is needed). So `edid_parse()` reports a
   horizontally WRONG active width for every detailed timing.

# RK3576 VOP+DSI 黑屏根因:D-Cache 一致性(最终突破)

## 结论(2026-08-30 最终定位)
framebuffer 在 RK3576 DMA 堆(0x49400000),MMU 映射为 MT_NORMAL
(Write-Back cacheable,见 nuttx/arch/arm64/src/common/arm64_mmu.h:
MT_NORMAL=4 -> MEMORY_ATTRIBUTES 0xff = Inner/Outer WB cacheable)。
ESMART 用 MMU_BYPASS=1 + YRGB_MST=物理地址,AXI 直接读 DDR,绕过 D-Cache。

=> CPU 写棋盘格只落在 D-Cache(dirty line),没刷到 DDR;ESMART 读 DDR 读到
未初始化脏数据(全0/垃圾) => 恒定黑帧 => 示波器数据 lane 差分平坦、
全黑/全白/棋盘格波形无区别。

## 这解释了之前所有"寄存器全对但仍黑"的困惑
- HS burst 正常发(~90µs 周期 LP)、ipi_busy=1、ipi_vid_fsm 递增 = 像素流在动(发黑数据)
- 所有寄存器 dump 全对 = 寄存器配对了,只有 DDR 字节是脏的
- 对应第十轮遗留二分:"数据是棋盘格但 panel 没显示" vs "VOP 实际输出黑帧"
  => 答案是后者(VOP 真输出黑帧,因 ESMART 读到脏内存)

## 修复(contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vop.c)
- rk3576_vop_initialize() 里棋盘格填充完成后加:
  up_clean_dcache((uintptr_t)fb, (uintptr_t)fb + priv->fblen);
- up_clean_dcache 在 arm64_cache.c,声明经 <nuttx/arch.h>(vop.c 已含)

## 后续待办(部分已解决, 2026-09-26)
- ✅ mmap + FBIO_UPDATE 路径已覆盖: 给 RK3576_VOP 加了 `updatearea` 回调
  (`rk3576_vop_updatearea`, 按行 clean 脏区), 并在 chips/rk3576/Kconfig 里
  `select FB_UPDATE`。LVGL fbdev 每帧发 FBIO_UPDATE, 所以 lvgl_demo 路径安全。
  注意 `config FB_UPDATE` 无 prompt, **只能在 Kconfig 里 select, 写 defconfig 会被静默丢弃**。
- ⬜ 仍未解决: `fb_write()`(nuttx/drivers/video/fb.c) 只 memcpy(fbmem), 不调
  updatearea/vtable, 所以 `cat img > /dev/fb0` 这类 write 路径仍无 flush。
  修法: 条件宏(CONFIG_ARCH_HAVE_DCACHE_WRITEBACK 等)在 fb_write 后加 up_clean_dcache,
  或让 fb_write 也走 vtable->updatearea。属 nuttx 核心改动, 动前先确认。
- ⬜ 或用非 cacheable 映射(MT_NORMAL_NC)重新映射 fb 堆,一劳永逸,但会牺牲 CPU 写性能。

## 教训
- 排查顺序:物理层(PHY/示波器) -> 命令链路 -> 时序寄存器 -> 时钟域 -> **cache 一致性**
  是最容易被漏的"最后一公里"。当"寄存器全对但仍黑/数据不变"时,先怀疑 DMA 一致性:
  检查 ①fb 堆 MMU 属性是否 cacheable ②DMA 引擎是否 bypass cache ③写后有没有 clean。
- 其它 DMA 驱动(dma/fspi/sai/sdmmc/usb)都正确调了 up_clean_dcache/up_invalidate_dcache,
  唯独 VOP fb 没有 —— 这是个遗漏,不是设计。
=== dual-pixel ===
# RK3576 VP0 是 dual-pixel (pixel_rate=2) ✅ 已确认

## 铁证 (Linux rockchip_vop2_reg.c, rockchip-linux/kernel develop-6.1)
```c
static struct vop2_vp rk3576_vp0 = {
    .win_dly = 10,
    .pixel_rate = 2,          /* ← 2 = 每 dclk 输出 2 像素 */
    .intr = &rk3568_vp0_intr,
    .urgency = &rk3576_vp0_urgency,
    .regs = &rk3576_vop_vp0_regs,       /* 类型 vop2_video_port_regs, 不含 pixel_rate */
    .ovl_regs = &rk3576_vop_vp0_ovl_regs,
};
```
- 对比: rk3572 附近是 .pixel_rate = 1 (单像素)
- pixel_rate 字段在 vop2_vp (上层) 结构体, 不在 vop2_video_port_regs

## 含义
- pixel_rate=2 → RK3576 VP0 每 1 个 dclk 周期输出 2 个像素 (dual-pixel)
- 面板像素率 = dclk × 1 (每周期 2 像素, 面板每像素占 0.5 dclk? 待精确核实)

## 与黑屏的关联 (根因链) — ⚠️ 见文末"重大修正"

## ✅ 重大修正 (2026-08-30, dsp_vcnt0 2x 是误导性线索, 非根因!)
拿到 Linux 三处铁证, 推翻了之前的两个错误结论:

### 铁证 1: dclk = crtc_clock, 无 pixel_rate 换算
`rockchip_drm_dclk_set_rate()` (rockchip_drm_clk.c):
```c
rockchip_drm_dclk_set_rate(vop->version, vop->dclk, adjusted_mode->crtc_clock * 1000);
```
`rockchip_rk3576_drm_dclk_set_rate()` 里每次都直接 `clk_set_rate(dclk, rate)`,
**没有任何 /2 或 pixel_rate 换算**。→ NuttX `clk_set_rate(dclk, 64M)` 是对的!

### 铁证 2: 时序寄存器按 crtc 像素直接填
`dw_mipi_dsi2_ipi_set()` 里 htotal/vact 等都 `= mode->crtc_hdisplay` 等直接填,
**DSI 侧不除 2**。VOP 侧 Linux 也按 crtc 像素填 htotal。

### 铁证 3: mipi_pixel_rate = crtc_clock/4 (只用于 PHY_IPI_RATIO)
`dw_mipi_dsi2_get_mipi_pixel_clk()`:
```c
dsi2->mipi_pixel_rate = (mode->crtc_clock * MSEC_PER_SEC) / (4 * k); // k=1
```
→ PHY_IPI_RATIO 分母 = 64M/4 = 16M, 正确值 1.5 = 0x18000 ✅ (NuttX 已对)

### 结论
- NuttX 当前 dclk=64M、时序 htotal=822、PHY_IPI_RATIO 分母 pixel/4 = 16M 三项**全对**!
- `pixel_rate=2` 已隐含在 `/4` 里 (dclk/4 = 每像素dclk(dclk/2) 再 /2)
- **dsp_vcnt0 实测 2x (152000 行/秒) 是 dual-pixel 模式下该调试计数器的固有行为
  (VP0 每 dclk 处理 2 像素), 不是时序/时钟配错, 是误导性线索, 勿再据此改时序/dclk!**

### 已撤销的错误改动
- 本轮曾把 `mipi_dclk_sel`(MIPI0_INFACE_CTRL bit21) 从 0 改成 1(Dclk out),
  依据是 clk_parent_name="dclk_out"。**这是错的**: 实际 MIPI 用的时钟 = dclk_core
  (dclk/4 = 16M, 见铁证3 = mipi_pixel_rate), 不是 dclk_out(dclk/8)。
  应保持 mipi_dclk_sel=0(Dclk core, 复位默认)。
  改后 INFACE=80200033 但 INT_ST_IPI 仍 0、dsp_vcnt0 仍 2x → 证实 dclk_sel 非根因。

### 真正根因方向 (尚未闭环)
- NuttX VOP/DSI 侧寄存器配置已全部对齐 Linux, 但 INT_ST_IPI 恒 0 = 像素流
  物理上没从 VOP dclk_core 走到 DSI IPI。
- 下一步重点: ①VOP 内部 dclk_core/dclk_out/mipi0_pixclk 分频链是否在 NuttX
  时钟树显式建模; ②pclk_vopgrf、VOP 输出到 MIPI 的时钟门控是否 enable;
  ③Linux dw_mipi_dsi2_enable 里 clk_management(clk_type 连续/非连续) 与
  ipi_set 的完整流程 NuttX 是否漏了某步。

## 1. 算术核对:审查给的数字全对

驱动里 software stride 是 `xres * 3`([rk3576_vop.c:1753](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vop.c#L1753)),分配(`fblen`)、`FBIO_UPDATE`、`putarea`、`fill/fill_bands` 全用它;只有寄存器那一处另算([rk3576_vop.c:698](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vop.c#L698)):

| xres | 软件行距 | `(3x/4)+(x%3)` 字 | ×4 字节 | 差 | 审查说法 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1280 | 3840 | 962 | 3848 | +8 B/行 | ✓ 原话 |
| 800 | 2400 | 602 | 2408 | +8 B/行 | ✓ 原话 |
| 1920 | 5760 | 1440 | 5760 | 0 | ✓ "恰好不暴露" |

## 2. 寄存器语义:VID 值必须等于「字节步长 / 4」

- TRM 明确该字段是字计数,且**行距必须是字的整数倍、不足处补 dummy 字节**:*"The virtual stride should be multiples of word (32-bit). That means dummy bytes in the end of virtual line if the real pixels are not 32-bit aligned."*([TRM Part2 L208378](<Rockchip_RK3576_TRM_Part2_V1.2_20240624.txt#L208378>))
- 同一张表里其它格式都是 `Ceil(字节数/4)`:RGB565 `Ceil(w/2)`、YUV `Ceil(w/4)`、ARGB888 `w` —— 单位是字,没有疑问([ESMART0_REGION0_VIR 条目 L193556](<Rockchip_RK3576_TRM_Part2_V1.2_20240624.txt#L193556>))。
- 硬件不可能实现 `w%3`:这个寄存器就是行距字计数,硬件拿它 ×4 作为行起点增量。写 962 就是告诉硬件"每行 3848 字节",而 CPU 按 3840 字节写 → 必然逐行错开。旁证:3848 不是整像素(3848/3 = 1282.67),不可能是 RGB888 的"虚拟宽度"。

能讲讲bug的原理吗？
是“给到vop的缓冲区stride尺寸对齐不符合vop硬件要求”导致的吗？

## 直接回答:不是

**缓冲区本身是合规的。** `3 × 1280 = 3840` 字节,正好是 960 个字(4 字节),完美满足 VOP "行距必须是 32 位字的整数倍"的要求。

真正的错误是:**驱动在内存里用的是 3840,却告诉硬件"每行 3848"。** 也就是同一个约束(行距)在两个地方各算了一次,两次算出了不同的数。对齐没问题,一致性有问题。

---

## 一、硬件是怎么理解这个寄存器的

ESMART 取数引擎没有"行号"概念,它只有一条地址规则:

```
第 y 行起始字节地址 = REGION0_YRGB_MST + y × (REGION0_VIR × 4)
该行内取 ACT_INFO 个像素(1280 个)
```

所以 `REGION0_VIR` 不是"宽度",是**相邻两行起点之间的字节距离,以 4 字节为单位**。TRM 里那句 "The virtual stride should be multiples of word (32-bit). That means dummy bytes in the end of virtual line…" 说的就是这件事:行尾允许有补齐字节,而寄存器记的是"补齐之后一行占几个字"。

于是驱动和硬件之间只有**一条**契约:

```
REGION0_VIR × 4  ==  priv->stride   (CPU 实际写的行距字节数)
```

为什么 Rockchip 要用"字"而不是"像素"做单位?因为 RGB888 是 3 字节/像素,用像素记行距在某些宽度下除不尽;用"字 + 行尾补齐"就永远是整数了。TRM 表里那些 `RGB565: Ceil(w/2)`、`YUV: Ceil(w/4)` 都是在告诉你"某宽度占几个字"——但**占几个字 ≠ 你的缓冲区行距是几个字**,只有当"虚拟宽度 = 可见宽度、且没有补齐"时两者才相等。

## 二、这个驱动里发生了什么

```c
priv->stride = xres * 3;                              /* 内存布局: 3840 B */
...
vir_stride = (xres * 3 / 4) + (xres % 3);             /* 寄存器:   962 字 = 3848 B */
```

第二行是照抄 TRM 的 RGB888 公式。这条公式在 `12 | xres` 时恰好等于 `字节/4`(720、1920 就是这种),其它宽度就是错的。硬件拿到 962 完全无从察觉——它不知道内存是怎么写的。

关键点:**两边各自都是"合法"的数**。3840 是合法的字对齐行距,3848 也是一个合法的字计数。没有哪个越界、没有哪个违规,所以没有任何硬件报错——只是它们描述的不是同一块内存。

## 三、错位怎么累积成可见花屏(1280×720)

屏幕第 y 行实际读的是内存 `[3848y, 3848y+3840)`:

```
源内存(CPU 写的)                  VOP 读的
row 0   @ 0                         @ 0            ✓
row 1   @ 3840                      @ 3848         左移 8 B  ≈ 2.67 px
row 2   @ 7680                      @ 7696         左移 16 B ≈ 5.3 px
...
row 479 @ 1839360                   @ 1843192      左移 ~1278 px(绕行一圈)
row 480 @ 1843200                   @ 1847040      = 源 row 481 的起点,整行错开
row 719 @ 2760960                   @ 2766712      越过 fblen 5752 B
```

两个后果:

1. **行内横向剪切(主体症状)**。第 y 行从行内偏移 `8y` 字节处开始读,即画面被向左卷了 `8y/3 ≈ 2.67y` 像素,左边被卷出去的部分从右边绕回来。720 行累计 `8×720 = 5760 B = 1920 px`,相当于 1.5 个屏幕宽。任何有横向细节的画面(文字、图标、渐变、竖线)会变成明显的斜锯齿;竖线会变成折返的斜线。
2. **帧尾越界**。最后约两行的读取地址已经超过 `fblen`,读到的是 DMA 堆里别的缓冲区(MMU bypass 直读物理内存,不会 fault,但屏底会出现脏行)。

## 四、为什么以前所有测试都看不见它

`hardware/rk3576_hdmi.h` defines the descriptor field map as

 * anything here -- 1920 + 88 + 44 + 148 = 2200 and 1080 + 4 + 5 + 36 = 1125 --
 * because 148500000 / (2200 * 1125) = 60.000 Hz exactly, and any typo in a
 * porch shows up as a non-60 refresh rather than as an obvious error.
 *
 * 148.5 MHz is also one of the rates the PHY's TMDS PLL table synthesises
 * exactly (mdiv 123 -> 2970 MHz VCO, /4 /10 /8 -> 148.5 MHz), so the achieved
 * pixel clock matches the nominal one and the 500 ppm self-check in
 * rk3576_vop.c cannot fire.
 */

#define KICKPI_K7_HDMI_XRES         1920
#define KICKPI_K7_HDMI_YRES         1080
#define KICKPI_K7_HDMI_HSYNC_LEN    44
#define KICKPI_K7_HDMI_HFRONT_PORCH 88
#define KICKPI_K7_HDMI_HBACK_PORCH  148
#define KICKPI_K7_HDMI_VSYNC_LEN    5
#define KICKPI_K7_HDMI_VFRONT_PORCH 4
#define KICKPI_K7_HDMI_VBACK_PORCH  36
#define KICKPI_K7_HDMI_PIXCLK       148500000u

 *
 * 165 MHz is DVI 1.0's single-link limit.  Above it a DVI link needs the
 * scrambling HDMI 1.4 introduced, and this driver implements neither
 * scrambling nor HDMI mode at all, so the PHY's own (much higher) capability
 * is not the relevant bound -- the link protocol is.  A sink whose preferred
 * timing exceeds this falls back to 1080p60 rather than being driven outside
 * spec.
 */

#define KICKPI_K7_HDMI_DVI_MAX_PIXCLK 165000000u

/* DVI is 8 bits per colour component, always.  10 bpc only exists on an HDMI

#define KICKPI_K7_HDMI_BPC 8

## 因为你的 HDMI 测试跑在 1920×1080,而 1920 恰好落在"免疫集合"里

这不是"和理论矛盾",而是这次测试又一次踩在了不出问题的点上。

### 一、先确认这次测试的宽度

`configs/hdmi` 这条路只有两个可能的模式,而**两个都是 1920 宽**:

- 硬编码回退模式:`KICKPI_K7_HDMI_XRES = 1920`([kickpi_k7_hdmi.c:98](contest2026_062_PharosTech/boards/rk3576/kickpi-k7/src/kickpi_k7_hdmi.c#L98),CEA-861 VIC 16)。
- EDID 首选模式:你记忆里那台 AOC 22B2WG5 的 DTD1 就是 `148.5 MHz, 1920/88/44/148 + 1080/4/5/36`,也就是 **1920×1080**,而且这个驱动**只采用 sink 的第一条 DTM**,不做模式列表选择([rk3576-hdmi-edid.md](/home/yunline/.vscode-server/data/User/workspaceStorage/de62cf27f9b529986a905d9b3ea54d6a/GitHub.copilot-chat/memory-tool/memories/repo/rk3576-hdmi-edid.md))。

所以无论 EDID 读成功还是回退,HDMI 都是 1920 宽。而 1920 是 12 的倍数:公式给出 `1920*3/4 + 1920%3 = 1440 + 0 = 1440`,而正确值 `5760/4 = 1440` —— **两者重合,寄存器没错**。

### 二、"免疫集合"是怎么来的

错误公式 `floor(3w/4) + (w mod 3)` 要等于 `3w/4`,必须同时满足:

- `4 | 3w` → `4 | w`(软件步长才是字对齐的)
- `w mod 3 == 0`(多出来的那项才是 0)

两条合起来就是 **`12 | w`**。今天这份代码**只有宽是 12 的倍数时才是完全正确的**:

| 宽度 | 公式值 vs 正确值 | 结果 |
|---|---|---|
| 720、1152、1440、1680、**1920**、3840 | 相等 | ✅ 免疫 |
| 800、1280 | +2 字/行(+8 B) | ❌ 斜切 |
| 640、1024、1360、1600、2560 | +1 字/行(+4 B) | ❌ 斜切 |
| 1366 | 公式歪打正着,但 3w=4098 不是字整数倍 | ❌ 每行错 2 B |

本项目**两条显示通路全都落在免疫集合里**:HDMI 1920×1080、MIPI DSI 720×1280(720 也是 12 的倍数)。所以这个 bug 从 bring-up 到现在,测试集从没进过失败区 —— 这才是它活到今天的原因,而不是"没有这个问题"。

### 三、LVGL 这条路并没有帮它挡住

我顺带查了 LVGL 的 fbdev 端口 [lv_nuttx_fbdev.c](apps/graphics/lvgl/lvgl/src/drivers/nuttx/lv_nuttx_fbdev.c#L137):它 `FBIOGET_PLANEINFO` 拿 `pinfo.stride`,mmap 后按这个 stride 逐行写,每帧 `FBIO_UPDATE` —— 也就是说它**老老实实按 3840 字节/行**往帧缓冲里画。VOP 若按 3848 读,该切还是会切。不存在"LVGL 自己另有一套布局,所以躲过了"的可能。

### 四、如果想用现有硬件亲眼看见

三个办法,按成本排序:

1. **换一台首选 timing 不是 12 倍数的 sink**:1366×768 的电视、1280×720 的显示器/投影、1024×768、1600×1200 都行。这是唯一"零改代码"的验证,而且正好覆盖审查里说的"EDID 选择这些分辨率后会逐行错位"。
2. **临时绕过 EDID 采用**:在 `kickpi_k7_hdmi_select_mode()` 里临时忽略首选 timing,硬套一组 1024×768@60(65 MHz)或 1280×720@60(74.25 MHz)的时序,跑 lvgldemo。
3. **只验证机制**:在 1920×1080 下把 VIR 故意写成 1441(即 5764 B/行),应当立刻出现同类斜切 —— 这能证明"VIR 就是行距字计数",再配合 1280 的算术(962≠960)即可定论。

症状可以提前预告,便于判读:1280 宽时每行偏 8 B = 2.67 px,而 8 与 3 互素,所以**通道对齐每行还会轮转**(R/G/B 依次错位),画面会是"斜切 + 彩虹色边"的锯齿状,不是单纯的平移。这一点纯色/横带图案永远看不出来,而 LVGL 的 UI(文字、边框、图标)必然会暴露。

### 五、需要你确认一个数

请查一下那次测试的启动日志里这一行:

```
kickpi-k7: HDMI mode from sink EDID: <宽>x<高> ...
```

- 如果打印的是 **1920×1080**(或"keeping 1920x1080"),那就和上面完全吻合,审查意见成立、无需再解释。
- 如果打印的是 **1280×720 / 1024×768 / 1366×768** 之类的宽度而 UI 依然笔直,那我就得推翻这套模型重新查 —— 那说明 VIR 的行为和 TRM 的描述、和 Linux 上游的写法都不一样,值得单独做一个寄存器实验。

要我现在把这个补丁(步长取字对齐 + 寄存器写 `priv->stride / 4`)改上去吗?改完我可以顺手把注释里那条 TRM 公式为什么不能用写清楚,免得下一个人再照 TRM 改回去。

text: 所以bug是两次stride计算用了两种不同的公式，导致在某些场景下计算结果不一致，出现斜切，对吗

对,核心就是这样。补三点让它更准确:

**1. 严格说是"同一个行距被表达了两次,而第二次不是从第一次换算出来的"。**

两处其实单位都不同:软件那处是**字节**(`priv->stride = 3·xres`),寄存器那处是**字**(行距 ÷ 4)。正确做法是 `VIR = priv->stride / 4` 这一个导出关系;代码却把寄存器值当成宽度的函数另算了一遍(照抄 TRM 那条 RGB888 公式)。于是同一件事有了两个独立来源,可以互相矛盾:

```
必须成立:  REGION0_VIR × 4 == priv->stride
前提:      priv->stride % 4 == 0        (寄存器只能表达整数字)
现状:      priv->stride  = 3·xres
           REGION0_VIR   = floor(3xres/4) + (xres mod 3)
⇒ 仅在 12 | xres 时成立
```

**2. "某些场景"可以精确成一句话:宽度不是 12 的倍数时。** 现实宽度都是 8 的倍数,所以错误方向只有一种 —— 寄存器报的行距**大于**真实行距(+4 B 或 +8 B/行,永不小于),症状因此可预测:逐行累积横向偏移(斜切)+ 帧尾越界读。

**3. 斜切只是症状之一,而且有个它盖不住的兄弟:帧尾越界。** 同一处不一致还让最后 1~2 行的取数地址跑出 `fblen`,读到 DMA 堆里别的缓冲区。这两件事同因,但表现不同 —— 前者靠内容才看得见(纯色/横带免疫),后者是屏底脏行。

另外别忘了还有**另一半**,它不属于"公式不一致":当宽度是 4 的倍数以外时(如 1366×768,`3w = 4098`),软件行距本身就**无法用这个寄存器表达**。这一半即使把公式换成 `stride/4` 也修不掉,必须先把行距补齐到 4100。审查建议里"软件 stride 按 4 字节对齐 + 寄存器用 stride/4"两句话正好覆盖这两半,缺一不可。

text: 能否使两处stride计算结果来自同一来源，而不是简单地复制粘贴公式？

thinking:
The user asks: can we make the two stride computations come from a single source, rather than just copy-pasting the formula?

This is a design question. They want a single source of truth so the mirror can't drift. Let me think about what the best design is in this codebase.

Current state:
- `priv->stride` (bytes) computed in `rk3576_vop_initialize()`: `priv->stride = (uint32_t)config->xres * 3;`
- Local `vir_stride` recomputed in `rk3576_vop_configure_layer()` from `xres`.
- Consumers of bytes: `fblen`, `getplaneinfo`, `updatearea`, `fill`, `fill_bands`.

The right fix: **the register value is derived from the byte stride, never recomputed**. Options:

**Option A (minimal, recommended): one derivation, one direction.**
```c
/* init */
priv->stride = ALIGN4(3·xres);          /* the only place a stride is computed */
priv->fblen  = priv->stride * yres;

/* configure_layer */
putreg(REGION0_VIR, priv->stride / 4u);  /* derived, not recomputed */
```
Delete the local variable entirely. This is "single source": `priv->stride` is the source; the register is a *view* of it. And `/4` is exact because init aligns.

But: is `priv->stride / 4` the "same source" or a copy of a formula? It's a unit conversion, unavoidable — the hardware's unit differs. The point is the conversion is applied *to the same variable*, so they can never disagree (except by the alignment precondition, which is enforced once at init and even asserted).

**Option B: store the word count alongside, computed once.**
```c
struct rk3576_vop_s {
  uint32_t stride;      /* bytes, the layout */
  uint16_t stride_words; /* = stride/4, what REGION0_VIR wants */
  ...
};
```
Set both in one place, then `putreg(..., priv->stride_words)`. This makes the register's unit explicit in the type/name, and the invariant is visible in one struct. Cost: a redundant field that can drift if someone reassigns `priv->stride` later. Could be mitigated by making `stride_words` a tiny accessor/inline function rather than a stored field:

```c
static inline uint32_t rk3576_vop_vir(const struct rk3576_vop_s *priv)
{
  return priv->stride >> 2;
}
```
That is strictly better than a stored duplicate: no second copy to drift.

**Option C: make the invariant checkable (DEBUGASSERT).**
The AGENTS.md discipline says: "A statement of a constraint states the constraint... When one rule is mirrored in two places, say so in both and change both together." A stronger approach for a driver that can't be unit-tested well here: encode the constraint as an assertion so drift is caught at build/boot rather than on the glass:

```c
DEBUGASSERT(priv->stride % 4u == 0u);          /* register is a word count */
DEBUGASSERT(priv->stride / 4u == (uint32_t)priv->stride_words);
```

Actually there's an even better trick available at compile time for the alignment property: since only `xres` matters, we can add a `DEBUGASSERT((config->xres * 3u) % 4u == 0u)`? No — after padding it's always true. Hmm, padding makes it unconditionally true, so the assert is about the *derivation* being applied. The meaningful assert is: padding happened before computing fblen, and the register is stride/4.

Hmm, what's the *real* residual risk after the fix? Two ways to reintroduce the bug:
1. Someone writes a per-format formula again (that's just a code review matter; mitigate with a comment that names the invariant and cites why the TRM formula is not usable).
2. Someone changes `priv->stride` after init (e.g. pan/dual-buffer support with a different pitch) without updating VIR. Mitigate: route the VIR write through a setter function that clamps/asserts, or only assign stride in one place.

In this repo's style (see AGENTS.md about mirrors), a good answer:
- Keep one derivation (`priv->stride` = the layout), make the register a pure function of it.
- Make the unit conversion a named single-point helper so the "words" concept appears once in the file.
- Add a `DEBUGASSERT` on the alignment precondition plus a comment that states the invariant `VIR × 4 == stride` and why the TRM per-format formula must not be used here (with the immunity condition 12|xres as the evidence).
- Optionally: a static helper `rk3576_vop_set_stride(priv)` that does both (fblen + register) so a future repaint/pan path can't update one without the other. But careful: at init the register isn't writable yet (ESMART domain powered down, mirror register), so they can't literally be one function called from init... Actually the register write must happen in configure_layer (after power-on, and it's a mirror register that must be followed by cfg_done). So a "set both" function isn't clean. Better: single computation + derived view + assert.

Another angle the user might want: "not literally copy-pasting the formula" — the deeper design point is **direction of derivation**. There are two possible designs:

(a) *Layout-first*: the CPU layout (`priv->stride`, bytes) is authoritative; the register is derived (`stride/4`). This matches reality because the layout is what the app/LVGL writes and what `pinfo->stride` publishes. → Recommended.

(b) *Register-first*: the hardware's word count is authoritative and the layout is derived from it (`stride = VIR*4`), with padding implied. ## 原则:布局是权威,寄存器是它的一个视图

内存怎么排,是 CPU(以及 LVGL/应用读 `pinfo->stride`)决定的事实;寄存器只是把这个事实**翻译成硬件要的单位**。所以正确的关系是单向的:

```
xres ──(全文件唯一一处换算: 3 B/px + 凑整到字)──► priv->stride  (字节 · 唯一事实)
                                                     ├─► fblen / pinfo->stride
                                                     ├─► updatearea / fill / fill_bands
                                                     └─► REGION0_VIR = stride / 4   (视图)
```

现在的问题恰恰是"视图"那一支**没有从 `priv->stride` 派生**,而是自己又从 `xres` 算了一遍 —— 同一件事有了两个入口,就能互相矛盾。

## 具体落地

```c
/* 唯一一处"从模式推导行距"。RGB888 = 3 B/px;凑整到 32 位字,因为
 * REGION0_VIR 以字计数,而 ESMART 每行按"含补齐字节"的整行距取数。 */
#define RK3576_VOP_RGB888_BPP 3u

static uint32_t rk3576_vop_pitch(uint16_t xres)
{
  return (((uint32_t)xres * RK3576_VOP_RGB888_BPP) + 3u) & ~3u;
}

/* 结构体里把不变量写在字段旁边,而不是只写在函数里 */
uint32_t stride;   /* Line stride in BYTES; REGION0_VIR = stride / 4 */
```

```c
/* rk3576_vop_initialize() */
priv->stride = rk3576_vop_pitch(config->xres);
priv->fblen  = (size_t)priv->stride * config->yres;
DEBUGASSERT((priv->stride & 3u) == 0u);   /* 否则寄存器根本表达不了它 */

/* rk3576_vop_configure_layer():删掉本地 vir_stride 与那条公式 */
  /* REGION0_VIR 是行距的"字"计数,必须与 CPU 实际写的布局一致,
   * 因此由 priv->stride 派生,不再从 xres 另算一次。
   * (TRM 的 RGB888 式子 (w*3/4)+(w%3) 只在 12|xres 时等于 stride/4 ——
   *  720x1280 面板与 1920x1080 HDMI 正是如此,1280/1024/800/1366 不是。) */
  rk3576_vop_putreg(priv, esmart_base + RK3576_VOP_ESMART_REGION0_VIR,
                    priv->stride / 4u);
```

如果想让"字"这个概念在文件里只出现一次,把它收成一行内联,调用点就更自证:

```c
static inline uint32_t rk3576_vop_pitch_words(const struct rk3576_vop_s *priv)
{
  return priv->stride >> 2;    /* REGION0_VIR 的单位 */
}
```

## 几个"看着像单一来源、其实是新镜面"的做法,建议避开

- **再存一个 `stride_words` 字段**。这只把"两份可以漂移的副本"从"公式 vs 变量"换成了"变量 vs 变量";将来谁改了 `priv->stride` 而忘了它,一样坏。派生(除法/移位)不需要维护第二份状态。
- **运行期读回寄存器做校验**。这个项目自己踩过:ESMART 那批是 mirror 寄存器,cfg_done 之前读回全是 0,拿它当契约会在正常路径上误报。契约应该立在**写入侧**(派生自同一个变量),而不是回读侧。
- **保留公式、只加注释说"两边要一起改"**。AGENTS.md 里那条"镜面漂移比没有镜面更糟"说的就是这种:靠人记住同时改两处,迟早会断。这里能靠结构消灭它,就不该靠纪律。

## 剩下的风险只有一种,用注释和断言挡住

修完之后,唯一还能把它弄坏的路径是**有人又用 `xres` 重算一次**(比如照着 TRM 的格式表加 RGB565/ARGB8888 支持)。所以:

- 注释要写明**不变量**(`VIR × 4 == priv->stride`)和**TRM 那条公式为什么不能用**,并把"12|xres 才巧合相等、所以 720/1920 从没暴露"这句证据留在旁边 —— 没有证据的注释,下一个人会当它写错;
- 将来加别的像素格式/双缓冲时,入口仍然是同一个函数(`bytes/px` 换成参数即可),行距只在那一处产生。

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: rk3576_vop_pitch
 *
 * Description:
 *   Derive the framebuffer's line pitch, in bytes, from the active width.
 *
 *   This is the ONLY place in the driver where a pitch is derived from a mode.
 *   The pitch is the layout the CPU writes and that any application drawing
 *   through mmap() walks, so it is what priv->stride carries, and the window's
 *   stride register must describe it rather than be computed a second time.
 *
 *   The pitch is rounded up to a whole 32-bit word because REGION0_VIR counts
 *   words: a pitch that is not a multiple of four cannot be expressed to the
 *   hardware at all.  The ESMART fetches one pitch per line, so the padding
 *   bytes at the end of a line are stepped over and never displayed.
 *
 * Input Parameters:
 *   xres - Active width in pixels.
 *
 * Returned Value:
 *   Line pitch in bytes, always a multiple of 4.
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

static uint32_t rk3576_vop_pitch(uint16_t xres)
{
  return (((uint32_t)xres * RK3576_VOP_RGB888_BPP) + 3u) & ~3u;
}

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: rk3576_vop_pitch_words
 *
 * Description:
 *   The same pitch in the unit the window's stride register counts: 32-bit
 *   words.  Derived from priv->stride, never recomputed from xres, because a
 *   second derivation of one constraint is free to disagree with the first.
 *
 *   The TRM's RGB888 entry, (Win_vir_width * 3 / 4) + (Win_vir_width % 3), is
 *   NOT the value to write here.  It equals stride / 4 only when 12 divides
 *   the width -- true for the 720x1280 MIPI panel and the 1920x1080 HDMI mode
 *   this driver was brought up on, false for 1280/1024/800/1366 -- and where
 *   it disagrees, the ESMART steps 4 or 8 bytes further along on every line
 *   than the CPU wrote: the picture shears, and the last lines fetch past the
 *   end of the framebuffer.  Upstream Linux writes this register the same way
 *   this does (DIV_ROUND_UP(fb->pitches[0], 4)), in the very commit whose
 *   message quotes that TRM line.
 *
 * Input Parameters:
 *   priv - Driver instance, after priv->stride has been set.
 *
 * Returned Value:
 *   Line pitch in 32-bit words, i.e. the REGION0_VIR value.
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

static uint32_t rk3576_vop_pitch_words(FAR const struct rk3576_vop_s *priv)
{
  /* rk3576_vop_pitch() rounds up, so this is exact. */

  DEBUGASSERT((priv->stride & 3u) == 0u);

  return priv->stride >> 2;
}

+/****************************************************************************
+ * Name: rk3576_vop_pitch
+ *
+ * Description:
+ *   Derive the framebuffer's line pitch, in bytes, from the active width.
+ *
+ *   This is the ONLY place in the driver where a pitch is derived from a mode.
+ *   The pitch is the layout the CPU writes and that any application drawing
+ *   through mmap() walks, so it is what priv->stride carries, and the window's
+ *   stride register must describe it rather than be computed a second time.
+ *
+ *   The pitch is rounded up to a whole 32-bit word because REGION0_VIR counts
+ *   words: a pitch that is not a multiple of four cannot be expressed to the
+ *   hardware at all.  The ESMART fetches one pitch per line, so the padding
+ *   bytes at the end of a line are stepped over and never displayed.
+ *
+ * Input Parameters:
+ *   xres - Active width in pixels.
+ *
+ * Returned Value:
+ *   Line pitch in bytes, always a multiple of 4.
+ *
+ ****************************************************************************/
+
+static uint32_t rk3576_vop_pitch(uint16_t xres)
+{
+  return (((uint32_t)xres * RK3576_VOP_RGB888_BPP) + 3u) & ~3u;

50:   `grep -ao "<a string from the new page>" cmake_out/<cfg>/nuttx`.
51: - **A stale binary looks like a stale source.** Before flashing, compare
52:   `nuttx.bin`'s mtime against every source, or just run ninja and confirm it has
53:   nothing to do.
54: - **The network structure pools are hard ceilings unless their `ALLOC_` setting
55:   is on.** Two of them cost days of this project: the callback pool, whose
56:   exhaustion makes `tcp_pollsetup()` answer `-EBUSY` and so makes `poll()` stop
57:   waiting altogether, and the connection pool, whose exhaustion makes the stack
58:   drop SYNs without a reply. Neither failure looks like a shortage of anything
59:   — the first looks like a broken `poll()`, the second like a dead network. See
60:   `nuttx-network-pools.md`, and the note at the top of `app/camenc/camenc_ws.c`
61:   for how the report shows which is short.
62: 
63: ## The encoder's frame geometry, and the magenta band
64: 
65: The encoder reads a source buffer as luma over `y_stride × v_stride` with the
66: chroma plane at **`y_stride × v_stride`** — the *allocated* height, not the
67: picture height. `v_stride = align(height, 16)`.
68: 
69: This bit 1920x1080: the picture is 1080 rows, `v_stride` is 1088, so the chroma
70: plane belongs at `1920×1088 = 2088960`. Code that used `height × stride`
71: (`2073600`) put it 8 rows early, leaving the bottom 8 chroma rows never written —
72: which a decoder shows as a **magenta band across the bottom 16 lines**, reading
73: whatever the memory last held. Every other mode has `align(h,16) == h`, so the
74: two agree and the bug stayed hidden.
75: 
76: **`src_size`/`dst_size` are allocation sizes, not picture sizes.** Anything that
77: fills NV12 as `w*h*3/2` will break on a height that is not a multiple of 16.
78: 
79: The capture driver writes exactly the picture geometry — luma stride `width`,
80: chroma at `width × height` — so for 16-multiple heights the two devices already
81: agree, which is what makes zero-copy possible at all.
82: 
83: ## Cache
84: 
85: The VEPU DMA **does not snoop**. The contract is explicit maintenance, and both
86: sides already do it: VICAP cleans the demosaiced frame after the demosaic, VEPU
87: cleans the source before a job and invalidates the destination after. The DMA
88: heap is normal, cacheable, identity-mapped memory with 64-byte lines, so a buffer
89: must be 64-byte aligned at both ends, or the maintenance touches its neighbours.
90: 
91: ## Streaming
92: 
93: - The WebSocket carries fragmented MP4, one fragment per frame.
94: - **Dropping a fragment breaks every following P picture**, and a decoder shows
95:   that as a frame of garbage rather than one missing frame. The recovery is to
96:   mark the client `waiting` and skip until the next key fragment; the encoder's
97:   key/P flags make that work.
98: - `CAMENC_WS_MAX_SEGMENT` is 512 KiB.
99: - camenc asks the encoder for groups of **15** pictures (`CAMENC_DEFAULT_GOP`);
100:   the driver's own default is 2 (`RK3576_VEPU_DEFAULT_GOP`). Measured on a drawn
101:   source: groups of 4 are 51% of the rate of groups of 2.
102: - The encoder has **no rate control** — it runs at a fixed QP, so the only lever
103:   on bitrate is the quantiser.
104: 
105: ## Zero-copy work: committed
106: 
107: `f191417 camenc: encode the camera's frames where they lie`, on branch
108: `supercat-camera` — `app/camenc/camenc_main.c`, `chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c`,
109: `chips/rk3576/vepu/rk3576_vepu_codec.c`, and a whitespace alignment in
110: `drivers/drivers/ov5647/ov5647.c` that a formatting pass contributed.
111:

113: when the demosaic fits`, which is the same idea one stage earlier in the
114: pipeline.

# RK3576 VOP framebuffer pitch

## The constraint

ESMART `REGION0_VIR` (`0x181C`) is the line pitch in **32-bit words**, so

    REGION0_VIR * 4 == the byte pitch the CPU wrote

and a pitch that is not a multiple of 4 cannot be expressed at all. TRM Part2
L208378: "The virtual stride should be multiples of word (32-bit). That means
dummy bytes in the end of virtual line if the real pixels are not 32-bit
aligned." The sibling formats in the same table agree with that reading
(RGB565 `Ceil(w/2)`, YUV `Ceil(w/4)`, ARGB888 `w`).

**The TRM's RGB888 entry, `(Win_vir_width*3/4) + (Win_vir_width%3)`
(L188805 / L193556), is not the value to write.** It equals `stride/4` only
when 12 divides the width. Upstream Linux quotes that very line in the message
of `da709a7b "drm/rockchip: vop: round_up pitches to word align"` and then
writes `DIV_ROUND_UP(fb->pitches[0], 4)` — the pitch, not the width.

## The bug this caused (fixed 2026-10-08)

`rk3576_vop.c` derived the pitch twice: `priv->stride = xres*3` for the layout,
and the TRM formula for the register. The two agreed exactly when `12 | xres`
— 720 (MIPI panel) and 1920 (HDMI) are both in that set, which is why
bring-up, every pure-colour test and the four horizontal band pattern never
saw it. Every other width was wrong by +1 word (1024/640/1600/2560) or
+2 words (1280/800/1360) per line: the picture shears (2.67 px/row at 1280,
and since 8 and 3 are coprime the R/G/B channels rotate per line — colour
fringing), and the last lines fetch past `fblen` into whatever follows.

The wrong conclusion to not repeat: the Copilot corpus
(`rk3576-mipi-dsi2-video-black.md`, round 109) recorded this formula as
"verified correct" — the check was `priv->stride=2160` vs `vir_stride=540`,
run only at 720 wide, where the two formulas are identical by construction.

## The fix

One derivation, in `rk3576_vop_pitch()`: `3 * xres` rounded up to 4 bytes.
`priv->stride` carries it; `rk3576_vop_pitch_words()` is the only place the
word unit appears, `priv->stride >> 2`. Do not store a second copy of the word
count and do not recompute from `xres`.

is **not** necessarily a multiple of 3 — `rk3576_vop_fill()`'s sweep had to
become `n + 3 <= fblen`. Anything else that walks the buffer 3 bytes at a time
needs the same care; `fill_bands()` is safe because it walks rows.

=== 3ca3c2c i2c: return OK from a successful transfer
The RK3576 I2C lower half passed rk3576_i2c_poll()'s result straight
back to the caller.  On success that result is the interrupt-pending bit
mask the poll matched -- an arbitrary positive number, not OK.

NuttX documents I2C_TRANSFER() as returning OK or a negated errno, and
callers reasonably test the result against OK, so every successful
transfer read as a failure to them.  The reverse reading hid it: a
caller testing `ret < 0` saw nothing wrong at all, so the two kinds of
caller disagreed about the same transfer and neither was told why.

It surfaced as a capture device whose sensor driver initialised
correctly yet whose open() then returned -ENODEV, because the raw
positive value had been forwarded up to the framework.

Report OK once the poll has reported success, which leaves the failure
path untouched.

only place the word unit appears.  The register now reads the layout the
driver actually allocated rather than re-deriving one from xres.  The
TRM's per-format line is deliberately unused, and the comment says why:
upstream Linux quotes that same line in da709a7b and then writes the
pitch.

One knock-on: the pitch is word-aligned, so fblen is not necessarily a
multiple of 3, and rk3576_vop_fill()'s 3-byte sweep had to stop short of a
partial trailing group or it writes past the allocation.  Only line
padding is left unwritten, which the window never displays.

Found by review, not by the board.  Verified so far: the object is clean
under -Wall -Wshadow -Wundef -Werror, clang-format is clean, the full
hdmi firmware links, and 1920x1080 HDMI plus 720x1280 MIPI DSI are
unchanged on hardware -- the fix computes the same values for both, so
that is a no-change check.  A width that is not a multiple of 12 has not
been on the glass yet.
EOF
